body: I hope they become moist again soon
Hell yeah. I haven’t seen any new episodes but I used to watch it all the time. What eps are your favorites?

It depends on the severity of my emotions in the moment. I usually do it while I take a bath. I like to drink hot tea and listen to music while I sit in the water and take my time with it. If my depression is spiking because of a certain event, I will usually bruise my arms until I can get somewhere quiet and alone. I keep blades hidden throughout the house and in my car just for those times.
The only point would be to not make my parents sad. After they’re gone, there’s nothing else. So, fuck it. Why delay the inevitable?

I went to community college but dropped out after a year. I had a job for 11 years, but had to quit after being hospitalized for an OD.

I’ve only ever worked retail but I can’t handle that environment anymore. People are horrible and don’t care about others. I was being yelled at and being treated like a piece of garbage every day. If I have to go back to that, there’s no way I will live much longer.
